controls.title: Controls & Interactions
controls.subtitle: Master the art of botanical discovery and deep inspection
controls.corePrinciple: Hover helps users discover more. Clicking helps users explore detailed information.
controls.hoverDesc: Hovering reveals nutrients, botanical properties, food info, and contextual hints without leaving your position.
controls.clickDesc: Clicking opens detailed clinical insights, selects nodes in Explore, enters quizzes, and launches deep-dive cards.
controls.keyboardDesc: Full accessibility support using Tab, Enter, Space, and Escape.
controls.demoSubtitle: Try hovering and clicking the specimen below to experience live feedback
controls.specimenTooltip: Rich in eugenol & adaptogenic antioxidants. Eases respiratory discomfort.
controls.drawerDesc: Ocimum sanctum has demonstrated adaptogenic support, reducing cellular stress and protecting mucosal linings.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Options
accessibility.subtitle: Tailor animations, text sizing, and visual contrast for your comfort
accessibility.reducedMotionDesc: Minimizes particle effects, radial rotations, and dramatic camera pans.
accessibility.textSizeDesc: Adjust interface typography scaling for optimal legibility.
accessibility.highContrastDesc: Enhances border luminescence, text brightness, and element separation.

data.title: Data & Progress Management
data.subtitle: Review offline storage and manage botanical progression
data.localNotice: SYLVARA stores all your game progress, badges, and preferences locally in your browser (IndexedDB and LocalStorage). Zero remote tracking.
data.resetDesc: Reset your Explore level progression, earned badges, and dependent quiz attempts back to Level 1. Your username, audio, language, and accessibility settings will NOT be touched.
data.modalWarning: Are you sure? This will relock Explore levels 2-25, clear earned badges, and remove dependent quiz scores. Unrelated preferences and settings will remain safe.
data.resetSuccess: Explore progress has been reset back to Level 1.
